Purple Roof Women’s Shelter Foundation has applied to Sida for funding of SEK 21,6 Million for their strategic plan 2024-2027 (agreement's activity period April 2024 - December 2027). The intervention aims to strengthen the struggle against Violence against Women (VAW) in Turkey, influence public policies to strengthen and improve support mechanisms for women victims of VAW, as well as to raise public awareness on gender equality and VAW. The intervention’s total budget is approximately SEK 30,5 Million, out of which 8,9 million SEK is contributed by other European donors.

Strategic Objective 1: Increase womens solidarity to strengthen the struggle with violence against women Strategic Objective 2: Policy Making and Disseminating Purple Roofs Politics of violence against women: Monitoring and Campaign
